subject.title: [Bug]: Regression: User-configured heartbeat prompt no longer respected

question: Should maintainers refresh the conflicting external fork PR, close/supersede it and sponsor a narrow same-repo fix, or split this into separate hint-mutation and transcript-placeholder repairs?
rationale: The bug remains source-reproducible, but an open external closing-syntax PR and a partially overlapping same-repo PR make duplicate automated repair unsafe without a maintainer choosing the canonical path.

options.title: Sponsor a narrow same-repo fix
options.body: Close or supersede the conflicting external fork path and land a focused same-repo repair with prompt-mutation and prompt-boundary regression coverage.

options.title: Refresh the external fork PR
options.body: Ask the fork PR author or a maintainer to rebase it, move it into a mergeable same-repo path if needed, and add proof for the full configured-prompt behavior.

options.title: Split the work
options.body: Treat the workspace-hint mutation and the transcript-placeholder/model-visible prompt behavior as separate fixes, with this issue staying canonical for the configured-prompt contract.

recommendation.title: Sponsor a narrow same-repo fix
recommendation.body: Close or supersede the conflicting external fork path and land a focused same-repo repair with prompt-mutation and prompt-boundary regression coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: This handle is tied to the path-hint commit and the first maintainer fix attempt for this regression.
